Français langue première.title: Fall Celebrations

Français langue première.title: Celebrating Our Learning
Français langue première.bigIdeas: We have grown as French speakers, readers, and writers. Our learning journey continues.

Sciences de la nature.title: Our Impact on Nature

Mathématiques.title: Numbers All Around Us
Mathématiques.titleFr: Les nombres tout autour de nous
Mathématiques.bigIdeas: Numbers help us understand and organize our world. We can see quantities without counting.
Mathématiques.assessmentPlan: Daily observations of counting, number recognition games, subitizing assessments with dot cards, math journals.
Mathématiques.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Counting to 10, concrete materials, partner support","developing":"Counting to 20, beginning subitizing, number writing","extending":"Counting beyond 20, instant recognition to 10, helping others"}
Mathématiques.indigenousPerspectives: Inuit counting systems, Mi'kmaq number stories, traditional counting games.

Mathématiques.title: Making Sense of Numbers
Mathématiques.bigIdeas: Numbers can be shown in many ways. We can compare amounts to solve problems.
Mathématiques.assessmentPlan: Number representation portfolios, comparison activities assessment, equal groups investigations, observation notes.
Mathématiques.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Numbers to 10, concrete comparisons, guided grouping","developing":"Numbers to 20, pictorial representations, independent work","extending":"Larger numbers, mental pictures, creating problems"}
Mathématiques.indigenousPerspectives: Traditional grouping methods, sharing circles ensuring equal distribution, beadwork patterns.

Mathématiques.title: Patterns and Shapes
Mathématiques.bigIdeas: Patterns help us predict what comes next. Shapes have special properties we can describe.
Mathématiques.assessmentPlan: Pattern creation assessment, shape sorting activities, pattern translation tasks, observation rubric.
Mathématiques.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"AB patterns, basic shapes, guided sorting","developing":"ABC patterns, shape properties, independent sorting","extending":"Harder patterns, 3D objects, creating sorting rules"}
Mathématiques.indigenousPerspectives: Patterns in traditional art and crafts, medicine wheel as circular pattern, drumming patterns.

Mathématiques.title: Adding and Subtracting
Mathématiques.bigIdeas: Addition brings groups together. Subtraction shows taking away or finding differences.
Mathématiques.assessmentPlan: Problem-solving observations, strategy documentation, fact fluency games, math stories assessment.
Mathématiques.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Facts to 10, concrete materials, number lines","developing":"Facts to 20, pictorial support, various strategies","extending":"Mental math, creating problems, helping others"}
Mathématiques.indigenousPerspectives: Traditional trading and sharing practices, story problems from Indigenous contexts.

Mathématiques.title: Mental Math Strategies
Mathématiques.bigIdeas: We can use strategies to solve problems in our heads. Equal means balanced.
Mathématiques.assessmentPlan: Mental math interviews, strategy sharing sessions, balance activities assessment, math talks.
Mathématiques.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Counting on, doubles, visual supports","developing":"Near doubles, making 10, decomposing","extending":"Efficient strategies, teaching others, creating challenges"}
Mathématiques.indigenousPerspectives: Mental math in traditional games, quick counting in cultural activities, oral math traditions.

Mathématiques.title: Measurement Exploration
Mathématiques.bigIdeas: We measure to compare and describe. Different tools help us measure different things.
Mathématiques.assessmentPlan: Measurement investigations portfolio, comparison activities, time awareness checks, practical measuring.
Mathématiques.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Direct comparison, simple units, daily time","developing":"Non-standard units, recording measurements, weekly time","extending":"Estimating first, standard units introduction, calendar time"}
Mathématiques.indigenousPerspectives: Traditional measurement methods, seasonal time keeping, measuring in nature.

Mathématiques.title: Problem Solving Adventures
Mathématiques.bigIdeas: Math helps us solve problems in our world. There are many ways to find solutions.
Mathématiques.assessmentPlan: Problem-solving rubric, strategy documentation, peer assessment, solution presentations.
Mathématiques.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Guided problem solving, concrete materials, peer support","developing":"Semi-independent work, choice of strategies, thinking skills","extending":"Creating problems for others, multiple solutions, leading groups"}
Mathématiques.indigenousPerspectives: Problem-solving in traditional stories, community problem-solving approaches, consensus building.

Mathématiques.title: Math Celebration
Mathématiques.bigIdeas: We have grown as mathematicians. Math learning is a journey that continues.
Mathématiques.assessmentPlan: Portfolio conferences, self-assessment reflections, peer celebrations, growth documentation.
Mathématiques.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Celebrating effort and growth, concrete displays, supported reflection","developing":"Showcasing strategies, helping younger students, goal setting","extending":"Mentoring others, advanced challenges, summer enrichment plans"}
Mathématiques.indigenousPerspectives: Celebrating learning in community, honoring all types of mathematical thinking, seven generations.

Sciences humaines.title: My Family and Our Class
Sciences humaines.bigIdeas: Every person is unique and special. Families are different and wonderful. We all have needs and wants.

Sciences humaines.title: Our Rights and Responsibilities
Sciences humaines.bigIdeas: We have rights and responsibilities. Good decisions help everyone. We can solve problems peacefully.

Sciences humaines.bigIdeas: We can find places using maps and directions. Our world has many special places. We belong to different communities.

Sciences humaines.title: Responsible Digital Citizens
Sciences humaines.bigIdeas: Technology can help us learn and connect. We must be safe and kind online. Digital citizens follow good rules.
